# Contributing to Allowgram

Use the [Allowgram contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for this repository.
Keep changes small and coherent, use accurate contributor identities, preserve
the account-specific allow-list and run the relevant checks.

The [original Telegram contribution guide](../docs/upstream-contributing.md)
is retained for provenance. Its upstream-specific acceptance and squash policy
does not replace this owner's request for atomic Allowgram publication commits.
